## Activity

This report covers activity at Market Eye Clinic for March 2020. During the reporting period, the clinic team completed 273 captures. This figure represents the recorded capture activity for the site during the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading information set out below.

The activity record should be read together with the quality and grading measures. These measures describe the proportion of captures that could not be graded, together with the number of results identified as referable and the median grading lag.

## Image quality

There were 8 ungradable captures during March 2020. The ungradable rate was 2.9 per cent. This rate is reported alongside the number of ungradable captures to provide both the count and the proportion for the site.

## Grading

A total of 47 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. The grading figures provide the recorded referable result count and the central measure of the time taken for grading during March 2020. Together, the activity, image quality and grading measures summarise operations at Market Eye Clinic for the reporting period.
